### Zoho CRM Pros and Cons: Top 5 Advantages and Disadvantages
#### Quick AI Summary Based on G2 Reviews
Users appreciate the **powerful AI features** of Zoho CRM, enhancing sales, marketing, and customer support seamlessly.

Users appreciate the **seamless integrations** of Zoho CRM, enhancing collaboration between Marketing and Sales processes effectively.

Users appreciate the **flexibility and ease of lead management** with Zoho CRM's extensive features and integrations.

Users appreciate the **easy integrations** in Zoho CRM, enhancing workflow efficiency and simplifying customer management.

Users find **limited features** in Zoho CRM restrict functionality, hindering integration and automation with other systems.

Users struggle with **integration issues**, finding the system inflexible and challenging to automate with non-Zoho tools.

Users find Zoho CRM's **complexity** challenging for beginners, often struggling to locate features and navigate the system.

Users often face **poor customer support** with Zoho CRM, leading to frustration and challenges during critical tasks.

## Top-Rated Alternatives
### Zoho CRM Reviews (2,954)
##### Filter Reviews
It makes it very, very easy to manage leads, especially when contacting them directly through phone calls, since it connects with my company mobile number. I also like the WhatsApp send feature, and we can even manage complaints through CRM management as well.

The feature I dislike is that it takes a lot of time to load and to move to other tabs. Sometimes it becomes very frustrating to message customers in bulk. Also, when closing a lead, a duplicate lead may or may not be created, which can be frustrating as well.

Zoho CRM is a comprehensive platform, but the large number of features can make the initial setup and learning process challenging for new users. Some advanced customizations require additional time to configure, and certain premium capabilities are only available in higher-tier plans.

The main thing I dislike about Zoho CRM is that it can feel a little complicated for new users. The user interface could also be more intuitive and easier to navigate.

One downside of Zoho CRM is that some advanced features can feel complex and take time to learn for new users.

"Zoho CRM Makes Lead Management and Customer Outreach Effortless"

4/5

What do you like best about Zoho CRM?

The best thing I like about Zoho CRM is the lead management in the software. It makes it very, very easy to manage leads, especially when contacting them directly through phone calls, since it connects with my company mobile number. I also like the WhatsApp send feature, and we can even manage complaints through CRM management as well. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about Zoho CRM?

The feature I dislike is that it takes a lot of time to load and to move to other tabs. Sometimes it becomes very frustrating to message customers in bulk. Also, when closing a lead, a duplicate lead may or may not be created, which can be frustrating as well. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What problems is Zoho CRM solving and how is that benefiting you?

Zoho CRM is solving many of our problems, especially with its strong lead management system and the ability to keep background details of each customer. It also helps me understand what the customer needs to be consulted on, so we can sell the right product or service accordingly. In addition, it maintains a database that lets us track customer feedback on our website. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

"Game-Changing 3CX Phone Integration with Smooth UI and Top-Tier Support"

4.5/5

What do you like best about Zoho CRM?

The phone API with 3cx integration has been a game changer for us. It automatically syncs our calls, logs customer data and keeps our operations running in one central dashboard. We also really like the workflows and automation features, which help us take care of our clients after the sale. The UI is clean and performance is smooth. The pricing is fair and makes sense with a central hub. The new AI reporting is very helpful for our reporting needs. Their customer support is top tier even on complex projects. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about Zoho CRM?

Zoho is powerful, it is definitely not a plug and play system in some cases. Setting up a custom multi account workflow and developer API configurations takes a lot of time and technical trial and error to get dialed in. The interface can feel cluttered sometimeand finding a specific setting or toggling features within nested mini apps can turn into a treasure hunt.. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What problems is Zoho CRM solving and how is that benefiting you?

Zoho CRM solves our issues buy putting our business lines, workflows, and automated communications tools into one clean space. The phone API integration with 3cx is awesome, syncing calls and logging customer data. The post sale automations keep things moving smoothly after a transaction closes, and the linking data across our business accounts make collaboration so much better. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.
